editorial:
Imagine moving into a room where you are not actually alone. You meet Justin, a teenager who is just trying to have some fun and explore his romantic side, but there is a big problem. A ghost named Emily lives in his room and she is not happy about his guests. She spends her time messing with his dates and making things awkward. It feels like a weird mix of a teen comedy and a sad love story. You get to see this strange bond grow between a living boy and a dead girl who both feel lonely in their own way.

The acting feels very natural and the chemistry between the two leads makes the story work. Some parts might feel a bit slow, but the emotional payoff at the end is worth it. If you enjoy stories about unlikely friendships and growing up, you will really like this one. For the best experience, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see the soft lighting of the room. If you are a fan of keeping movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to own this hidden gem.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Justin has to make a hard choice about his promise to join Emily in the afterlife. Instead of giving up on his own life, he helps Emily find peace so she can finally move on. They share a heartfelt goodbye that shows they both learned how to let go. Emily disappears for good, and Justin decides to embrace his future and grow up, finally free from the ghost in his room.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky romance and ghost stories with a heart.
